blocks.text:
Tories accuse PM of ‘degrading’ Downing Street as Max Balegde takes down clip of himself miming explicit lyrics

Andy Burnham is facing a backlash for inviting social media influencers to Downing Street after one of a group attending an event posted a clip of himself miming to a viral song with explicit lyrics outside No 10.

Downing Street said it was right that Max Balegde had taken down a TikTok post of him mouthing the words to “bomboclaat pussywagon chicken nuggets” after attending an event at the prime minister’s residence.
